reasoning_content:
Now let me test LDAP-user login (user1/password1) — the app is expected to allow LDAP authed users. But maybe those LDAP users are not app users. Let's check app logic quickly. Actually the guide says LDAP test users are configured for development. Let me try login with user1/password1.

Also test the `/login` LDAP search page (suchtext field) which is the LDAP search. Let me test.

action.command: cd /tmp; rm -f cj2.txt; curl -s -c cj2.txt -o /dev/null http://tfm-fachplanung.ddev.site/login; echo "== LDAP user1 login =="; curl -s -b cj2.txt -c cj2.txt -o p2.html -w "%{http_code} -> %{redirect_url}\n" -d "user=user1&pass=password1&login-submit=Anmelden" http://tfm-fachplanung.ddev.site/login; echo "== follow =="; curl -s -b cj2.txt -c cj2.txt -o a2.html -w "%{http_code}\n" -L http://tfm-fachplanung.ddev.site/; grep -io '<title>[^<]*</title>' a2.html | head -2; echo "== error msgs =="; grep -ioE '(Anmeldung[^<]*|Benutzer[^<]*nicht[^<]*|Fehler[^<]*)' p2.html | head

tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /tmp; rm -f cj2.txt; curl -s -c cj2.txt -o /dev/null http://tfm-fachplanung.ddev.site/login; echo \"== LDAP user1 login ==\"; curl -s -b cj2.txt -c cj2.txt -o p2.html -w \"%{http_code} -> %{redirect_url}\\n\" -d \"user=user1&pass=password1&login-submit=Anmelden\" http://tfm-fachplanung.ddev.site/login; echo \"== follow ==\"; curl -s -b cj2.txt -c cj2.txt -o a2.html -w \"%{http_code}\\n\" -L http://tfm-fachplanung.ddev.site/; grep -io '<title>[^<]*</title>' a2.html | head -2; echo \"== error msgs ==\"; grep -ioE '(Anmeldung[^<]*|Benutzer[^<]*nicht[^<]*|Fehler[^<]*)' p2.html | head", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Test LDAP user login"}
